privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Muhandes HUB, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) of Saudi Arabia.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.item1: Registration data: Name, email, phone number, company name
dataCollection.item2: Verification data: Commercial registration, VAT certificate
dataCollection.item3: Usage data: Platform activity, preferences, browsing history
dataCollection.item4: Transaction data: Deal details, payments, commissions

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.item1: Providing platform services and managing your account
dataUsage.item4: Sending notifications and updates related to your activity
dataUsage.item5: Improving user experience and developing the platform

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.description: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We may share your data in the following cases:
dataSharing.item1: With other parties in deals (necessary information only)
dataSharing.item2: With service providers (payment gateway, email service)
dataSharing.item3: When requested by official authorities per Saudi regulations

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.item1: Access your personal data and request a copy
rights.item3: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal requirements)
rights.item5: File a complaint with the relevant authority

security.title: Data Security
security.description: We use advanced encryption technologies and strict security measures to protect your data, including SSL/TLS encryption and limited access policies.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: We retain your data throughout your use of the platform and for 5 years after account closure per legal and regulatory requirements.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: For any inquiries about your data privacy, please contact: privacy@muqawilhub.com

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using Muhandes HUB, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

registration.title: Registration & Account
registration.item1: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account
registration.item2: You must provide accurate and truthful information during registration
registration.item3: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials
registration.item4: The chosen role (project owner, contractor, supplier, buyer) cannot be changed after registration

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions & Payment
subscriptions.item1: Four subscription plans are available: Starter (free), Pro, Business, Enterprise
subscriptions.item4: Paid amounts are non-refundable except in specific cases

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.item1: Commission is calculated based on the seller's subscription plan: Starter 2%, Pro 1%, Business and Enterprise 0%
commissions.item2: Commission is charged upon successful deal completion
commissions.item3: Commission must be paid within 14 days of the due date

postsAndOffers.title: Posts & Offers
postsAndOffers.item1: All posts are subject to admin review before publishing
postsAndOffers.item2: Content must be accurate and not contain misleading information
postsAndOffers.item3: Administration reserves the right to reject any post that violates platform policies
postsAndOffers.item4: Submitted offers are binding and cannot be retracted after award

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.item1: Reviews can only be added after deal completion
reviews.item2: Reviews can be edited within 48 hours only
reviews.item3: Reviews must be honest and objective

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.item1: The platform is a technical intermediary and is not responsible for work or product quality
liability.item2: Parties are responsible for verifying information before transacting
liability.item3: We are not liable for indirect damages or loss of profits

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.description: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of any material changes.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
